description: Run deterministic data-quality rules against one JSON object or up to 10,000 records. Checks required/non-empty fields, types, numeric ranges, allowed values, email/URL formats, and uniqueness. Returns a weighted quality score and actionable row-level issues. Example: invoke data_quality_check with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

maxIssues.description: Value for the maxIssues parameter of the data_quality_check tool; follow its schema constraints.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

rules.description: Quality policy rules encoded as JSON text.

workspaceToken.description: Secret API token for the workspace; keep it private.

name: data_quality_check
